items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Because Lane used to come get me when I was in short pants. Yeah. That's where I started with Lane.

ctx.x: Did you ever play in Papa Lane's band? No, no.
Because Lane used to come get me when I was in short pants. Yeah. That's where I started with Lane. I was in short pants. What kind of job? He's living here too. Yeah. He's still alive.
What kind of job did Lane get?

items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: Jack Lane used to have three bands. Called Reliance Band. Number one, number two, and number three.

ctx.x: When were you born? I was born in 93. 93. So you remember? I remember. You remember way back.

I remember the colored bands they had all around the city of New Orleans. The Imperial Band. The Superior Band. The Olympia. The Night Millennial. The Tuxedo Band. All the colored bands. They go around. In the days when they'd give a dance, they would sing this band that would play for the dance. They'd go around on a truck. Call it a furniture wagon. Old time furniture wagon. Remember why I see people? How they moved furniture in the old days? Yeah, it was a bandwagon. Yeah. And they put sides on there, you…
That was a dollar man had for the whole band.
